factorial_interpretation: T0/T1/T2/T3: single versus paired sampling crossed with value-network GAE versus Monte-Carlo return minus Q_commit; T4 versus T3 adds consistency
paired_token_loss_weight: 2*p(world); separate from the identical shared advantage

prompt_deduplication.compare: all actual image bytes and all text token IDs including serialized history

temporal_boundaries.pre_evidence: decision_index < tau, or tau not reached
temporal_boundaries.consistency: select and decision_index >= own x_seen_step; undefined x_seen_step is ineligible
temporal_boundaries.stay_consistency: both selects must independently satisfy own x_seen_step boundary

q_commit.normalization_domain: all publicly selectable candidates, excluding observation actions
q_commit.no_selectable_marks: Q undefined; T2 original token GAE, T3/T4 identical prior-weighted same-position token GAE
q_commit.invalid_action_before_tau: syntactically unparseable output only: T2 original token GAE, T3/T4 identical prior-weighted same-position token GAE; action_valid=false alone does not define fallback

awaiting_T04_freeze.common_config_and_gae_parameters: section1b credit/KL subset frozen in configs/rl_common.yaml: masked_gae gamma=1 lambda_GAE=1; complete T04 training configuration still requires its separate freeze
awaiting_T04_freeze.upstream_token_to_decision_advantage_and: Q-based pre-evidence decision scalar is broadcast to every reply token; fallback preserves token GAE (paired: prior-weighted same-position tokens); critic keeps original raw GAE plus V
awaiting_T04_freeze.realized_return_discount_definition: undiscounted realized task rewards only, excluding KL; KL is actor low_var_kl loss with pinned VAGEN default coefficient 0.001
awaiting_T04_freeze.any_advantage_normalization_order: raw unnormalized masked token GAE -> pre-evidence replacement -> one unweighted whole-batch masked whiten -> separate 2p(world) paired PPO token-loss weights
awaiting_T04_freeze.stay_selection_distribution: complete actual selectable candidate scores, normalized over select candidates
awaiting_T04_freeze.holdout_eval_decoding_and_budget_contrac: greedy; each held-out pair both worlds once; D+1 turns, maximum256tokens per turn

S1.scope: every pre-evidence decision plus every independent decision unit, including observed zero-pre-step units
S1.independent_unit: episode for T0/T2; pair_instance for T1/T3/T4
S1.c_u: sum of applied pre-evidence advantages times trajectory token-loss weight; divide by 2 only for paired units
S1.planned_s1_statistic: empirical variance of c_u divided by independent unit count; computed later, ddof not chosen here
